name: Shiramine Yuuki
source:
He holds the position of fencing team captain at a high school in Taito. He's tall and handsome, with flowing blond hair. He believes that women are the human race's one true treasure, and he can't help but make his presence known when he meets a beautiful woman.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/tokyotwilightghosthunters/characters/]official website[/url]]
